claims.statement: The legacy URL table is split into sections with a description, moved paths, gone paths and an optional permanent flag; moved paths answer 301, or 307 when the section sets permanent false, and gone paths answer 410.

buildLegacyTable rejects sources that are not a flat valid slug or are reserved routes, a source repeated across sections, targets that leave the site or contain backslashes, whitespace or control characters, and chains where a target is itself a source.
loadLegacyTable logs an invalid table and returns an empty map, so a bad row disables redirects without taking the site down; the table is built once at module load.
Lookups lowercase the path, strip a trailing slash and ignore paths with a sub-path, since the table holds only first-level URLs.

The proxy redirects a moved legacy URL to its target on the public site origin without the old query string, and answers a gone URL with a standalone Spanish 410 page in the visitor's mode and free theme.

The 410 page is standalone HTML with inline CSS and no stylesheet, font or script, using the colors of the visitor's free theme in their mode (Amakna dark by default), which a test checks against theme.css.
The table holds hubs and metalogros sections kept by hand with 301 redirects and a generated stubs section with temporary 307 redirects and 410s.
Pages still live on Squarespace, such as classes, dungeons, legal pages, /metalogro-krosmoz and the checklists not yet ported, are not in the redirect table.

The root-slug hook and the slug field validator reject a quest guide, achievement page, Dofus guide, checklist or standalone page slug that is a legacy table source, while metalogros are exempt because their slug is a panel anchor.

pnpm redirects:stubs reads the public REST API of a deployed site, dev by default or --from an origin, maps each crawled empty Squarespace stub Torre has not filled to an achievement page, pending, gone, ambiguous or skipped outcome, and rewrites only the stubs section unless --dry-run is passed.

A stub whose achievement page is in preparation gets no row and answers 404, a stub with no page to wait for gets 410, a name matching several achievements is left out for STUB_OVERRIDES, and --cutover makes the stub redirects 301.

sitemapEntries lists the home page, the metalogros, Dofus guides and checklists indexes, and every published page in the published state, standalone pages included, whose slug is a valid page slug and not a legacy table source, with absolute URLs, lastModified dates and no duplicates.
An index's sitemap date is the latest change among what it shows, including in-preparation entries, and the home page's date is the latest of the guides and the indexes.

The sitemap route is force-dynamic and caches an anonymous-visitor read of published documents with unstable_cache under the guide-pages, achievement-pages, dofus-guides, checklists and pages tags and the guide pages' revalidate interval.
robots.txt disallows everything in dev and elsewhere allows everything but /admin and points at the sitemap on the public origin, which siteUrl refuses to default in production.

The redirects E2E spec checks a hub's 301, a metalogro's panel, a published stub's 307, the 410 page, 410 and 404 stubs, the sitemap without drafts, panel or API, robots.txt pointing at the sitemap, the home canonical URL and a changed slug's 308 to its new page.

When a published page of quest guides, achievement pages, Dofus guides, checklists, standalone pages, class pages or dungeon pages is published with a different slug, the slug move hooks store a redirects row from the old slug to the new one marked auto, and any row whose source is the newly published slug is deleted.

A redirects row is validated and shortened on save: both slugs lowercased, an invalid or legacy-owned slug, a loop and a source a published page still uses are rejected, the target is the end of any chain, and rows pointing at its source are repointed at its target.
The slug route consults the cached redirects table only when nothing published has the slug, follows the chain to its end and answers a 308 to the target, or 404 on no row or a loop.
The 410 page is left aligned with the site's side margins, uses system fonts and renders «Volver a la portada» as a filled primary button.

The hubs section sends the old -datos checklist data pages to their checklist and answers 410 for test copies, /cart and /subscribe, and the metalogros section sends /metalogro-misiones-principales to the world quests anchor.

Stubs Torre filled with quest guides after the crawl are listed in FILLED_STUBS and left out of the stubs section, so their guide answers; a stub that names a quest no ta-web achievement asks for gets 410 with its own reason.

siteLinkHref makes a link to Torre's own site relative when this site serves the path (an own route, a non-410 legacy row or a live slug), and otherwise points it at Squarespace, leaving links to other sites alone.

readLiveSlugs reads as an anonymous visitor the published quest guides, the achievement pages, Dofus guides, standalone pages and checklists in the published state and the changed slugs, cached under every page tag, and withSiteLinks rewrites every Lexical link or autolink URL in loaded data without touching the cached original.
